notes.title: Blood Hunting Officially Released
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538342/e815326cca02de6fa6560ec13d0770798981e74f.png[/img]Welcome to Blood Hunting, where you begin your journey.  

Your role as Chase in this first-person survival horror game is to uncover the truth behind the mystery of his family's death.    

An unknown stranger helps by sending text messages to your phone.  As you uncover the truth you become aware of what you must do. Unfortunately, those responsible have begun to hunt you as well.

You have to survive long enough to discover the truth and try to do something about it.  This sets the stage on how dangerous revenge can be...if you can survive it. 

We hope you enjoy the experience.

notes.title: Blood Hunting is now on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538342/b00259ebad675e932ef2e828f60469ebf617a0f7.png[/img][h3]After years of development, we are happy to announce that Blood Hunting is on Steam.  

The game will be released soon so feel free to watch the trailer.  

We have added a few screenshots from the game as well.  

Let us know what you think and be sure to add to your wishlist.[/h3]
